## Pull request overview

This PR completes all remaining code-deliverable items in the ROADMAP, specifically sections C.5 (Production Hardening), §1.2 (WCAG 2.1 AA Audit), §1.3 (Responsive Storybook Stories), and §1.4 (Visual Regression Tests). The implementation adds critical production-ready infrastructure including security policies, performance monitoring, accessibility compliance, and comprehensive testing.

**Changes:**
- Added WCAG 2.1 AA compliance with comprehensive axe-core test suite (30 tests) and fixed Slider accessibility issue
- Implemented production hardening: CSP meta tag, modulepreload Vite plugin, deployment documentation, error tracking guide, and performance budget CI
- Created responsive layout Storybook stories for ResponsiveGrid and AppShell components
- Established visual regression testing infrastructure using DOM snapshots

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 13 out of 13 changed files in this pull request and generated 1 comment.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| `packages/layout/src/stories/ResponsiveGrid.stories.tsx` | Added 7 responsive grid stories demonstrating breakpoint-based column layouts |
| `packages/layout/src/stories/AppShell.stories.tsx` | Added 2 app shell stories showing responsive dashboard and minimal layouts |
| `packages/components/src/ui/slider.tsx` | Fixed WCAG violation by forwarding aria-label/aria-labelledby to Radix Thumb |
| `packages/components/src/__tests__/wcag-audit.test.tsx` | Comprehensive WCAG 2.1 AA audit with 30 axe-core tests for all UI components |
| `package.json` | Added storybook:test:snapshot scripts for visual regression testing |
| `apps/console/vite.config.ts` | Implemented preloadCriticalChunks plugin to inject modulepreload hints |
| `apps/console/index.html` | Added Content Security Policy meta tag with documented constraints |
| `apps/console/docs/error-tracking.md` | Complete Sentry integration guide with custom alternative |
| `apps/console/docs/deployment.md` | Cache-Control documentation with Nginx/Caddy/Vercel/AWS configurations |
| `ROADMAP.md` | Checked off 8 completed items across C.5, §1.2, §1.3, §1.4 sections |
| `.storybook/test-runner.cjs` | Added postVisit DOM snapshot capture for visual regression testing |
| `.github/workflows/visual-regression.yml` | CI workflow for visual regression tests on component changes |
| `.github/workflows/performance-budget.yml` | CI workflow enforcing 60KB gzip budget for main entry chunk |
</details>

The import of `toMatchSnapshot` from 'jest-snapshot' is unused and appears to be unnecessary. The `expect(innerHTML).toMatchSnapshot()` on line 30 uses the global `expect` object provided by the Storybook test-runner environment, not this import. Additionally, 'jest-snapshot' doesn't appear to be listed in package.json dependencies. This unused import should be removed to avoid potential dependency issues and improve code clarity.
